forum.title: Toolchain not detected by Cube AI studio v1.2
forum.best_answer_content:
Thank you for your response.

Updating proxy settings on each involved application has actually solved my problem.

I guess it couldn't download any updates, hence this bug. It has also solved the unwritten log files bug.

I have added the versions of each tools in the initial post, just if needed for the other users.

Thank you very much for your help !
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I am trying to create a project with Cube AI studio v1.2.

My toolchain and libraries are well detected with Cube AI studio v1.1, and I can create a project.

However, it is not the case for the Cube AI studio v1.2. The toolchain paths seem valid, but when creating a project no IDE is proposed at all, as shown in the attached image.

Could you help me please ? No debug logs are generated.

Versions :

* Cube AI studio : 1.2

* CubeMX : 6.17

* CubeIDE: 2.1.1

* CubeProgrammer : 2.22.0

* EdgeAICore : 4.0
forum.author: stm-trt

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @stm-trt ,

Could you share what are the dependencies version you have for 

- STM32CubeIDE

- STM32CubeMX

You also mentioning that  you don't have any logs. Does it mean that the folder C:\Users\<username>\.stm32cubeaistudio\logs is empty ?

If yes, could you check that all instances of STM32Cube AI Studio are killed in the Task Manager and the folder .stm32cubeaistudio is writable ? 

 

 

Best regards,

Yanis
